title: Accurate ocean and water access detection in US Statedle
body:
US STATEDLE QUESTION UNDERSTANDING
- Specific ocean questions (Atlantic, Pacific, Arctic, Indian, Southern, and Gulf of Mexico) now accurately evaluate access to the requested water body instead of falling back to generic coastal status.
- Added recognition for common Atlantic Ocean typos (including "Antlantic") in English and Polish so queries do not incorrectly produce false-positive matches for Pacific coastal states.
- Questions referencing unrecognized ocean names safely fall back to the knowledge base.
